posts.subject: broken surf_ski_2go/TTT
posts.bodyHtml: For some reason the word "camping" can not be typed on the surf ski server neither on the TTT server (info from ttt by @Luckiris) which is a problem if they do a !calladmin or just wanna type the word, and I been receving complains that some players have problems even writing in chat. It does not post it in the chat so they have to type it about 5 times until it comes up in chat for a reason (main chat). If this could be looked in to that would be great, thank you!

// EDIT: so me and @Luckiris check on surfski, TTT, bhop and knife so basically "all" servers have this problem, and before you go on the server and try to type "camping" it will work cause you are an admin, but if you have no rights on the server "as an normal user" it will not work


(sorri for double post)
After some testing with @WHAT , the word camping can be written with at least 4 capital letters. I will investigate that by looking on the internet.

I got informed of this problem almost 2 weeks ago when I was on the server, from a player (Schockly), in my opinion, it should be from one of the new plugins on the server because it wasn't like this before as far as I know.


@Nachtfrische
if you already knew this for 2 WEEKS why haven't you said it to the leadership then? @Mas0n

@Luckiris
Maybe it has to do something with the !camp command by your plugin?

@Nachtfrische


The problem is related to a word in chat and none of my plugins on servers are modifying the chat.


And even if it would be my plugins, I don't see why I would filter the chats for the word camping anyway.


The weird thing is :
- camping work for admins and not normal players
- CaMpInG works for everyone, if you put 4 capital letters in any orders it works, so cAMPIng, caMPINg, etc ...


In conclusion, it's very unlikely one of my plugins and the command is /camp not /camping so it would not make any sense.

EDIT : I did a simple test on my test server


On my local test server, I did one simple test.


Activate only the supporter menu, extended admins functions and the connect message and the word camping works all the time.


There must be a plugin which is making some stuff buggy.

Zitat von WHAT

if you already knew this for 2 WEEKS why haven't you said it to the leadership then? @Mas0n

first of all, because I didn't feel it's necessary to do, yeah I get it, it's a bug, but you can still write the word camp and as a user, you can explain anything related to camping with the word camp.



second of all, because i didn't wanted ? and that's none of your business ?




and if I ever wanted to talk about something like this, I would do it in private and not here because the only people who can help and know plugins, are @Nachtfrische @wickedy and @Luckiris,



so you do you, i do me, K?!?
